notes: Fitted by inst/memory/calibrate.R against 26 measured points on Darwin arm64 (rss-sampling), model kumo-tabular-small-classifier, re-measured 2026-11-06 after Kumo's layer loops started collecting between layers (#99). Constants are for the peak_terms() formulas as they stand; changing either invalidates the other. safety_factor is whatever it takes for no measured point to sit above its own estimate. The ensemble envelope is set by hand to the smallest log2 line that covers both member sweeps: at 3200 x 32 (measurements/ensemble-kumo.json) the collection has flattened the growth to 1.09x over 32 members (fitted 0.024, cap 1.31), but at 800 x 32 the allocator still adds a near-constant 1.6-3.0 GB to a 1.3 GB transient (3.3, 3.9, 4.7, 5.0, 5.1, 6.3 GB at 1-32 members), and covering its 32-member point takes 0.25 with a cap of 2.25.
